text:
maria_sales: Heads up 12 Aurora Labs (trial -> paid) flagged an overage for Mar that they're asking be retroactively discounted due to ambiguous SLA in the SOW. Need quick decision.

devin_revops: How big is the overage and where's ambiguity in SOW?

maria_sales: Invoice shows $16,400 over expected. They point to section 3.2 that mentions "limited test traffic" but language is vague. They say they interpreted it as excluding short bursts for acceptance testing.

sam_finance: @billing-bot paste invoice summary + audit

billing-bot: Invoice AUR-2026-03:
1) Hosted API usage: $37,900
2) Trial credit applied: -$5,000
3) Onboarding promo: -$2,500
Net due: $30,400
Overage claim: ~$16,400 linked to acceptance test days. Token audit attached to ticket #BILL-3178.

devin_revops: So partial credits were auto-applied, but disagreement remains. Aurora is small but strategic for our healthcare connectors roadmap; potential ARR ~120k.

garcia_legal: If the SOW wording is ambiguous we should fix contract language. For retroactive concessions, recommend documenting exception and adding explicit test traffic carveouts going forward.

sam_finance: My tolerance for goodwill credit without exec sign-off is $7k. Above that needs CFO or CRO approval. Proposal: offer $10k max if they sign a 12-month minimum committed plan and move to prepay/Net30.

maria_sales: Customer asks for full $16.4k waiver. They're worried about startup cashflow and prefer invoice reset.

devin_revops: Churn risk moderate. But a 12mo commit locks value. Can we require SRV-level SLA and a clause that they notify before acceptance tests? Also add billing flag for test keys.

sam_finance: OK to approve up to $10k conditional on: 1) signed 12mo commitment within 10 business days, 2) amendment clarifying test traffic billing, 3) tag in deal-exceptions ledger. Post-credit, we will shift them to Net30 prepaid for first quarter.

garcia_legal: I'll prepare an amendment and exception memo. We should add a narrow retroactive waiver clause in the memo and ensure it doesn't set a precedent.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-AUR-2026-03 for $10,000. Awaiting amendment upload to apply.

maria_sales: Aurora verbally agreed to 12mo commit in exchange for $10k credit. I'll get signature by EOD Thu.

devin_revops: I'll add a billing rule to suppress test traffic flagged via metadata and set an alert for any spike >3x baseline.

billing-bot: Applied credit once amendment uploaded. Please confirm file location.

maria_sales: Uploaded signed amendment at 1801290000. Please apply credit.

billing-bot: Credit applied. Updated net due: $20,400. Invoice adjusted and exception logged in deal-exceptions ledger #DE-524.

sam_finance: Approving $10k one-time credit. Documentation collected. Closing thread.
